title: Surprising Success, Repeated Failure: Entropy-Guided Credit Assignment for Exploration in LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.33781v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) enhances reasoning in large language models (LLMs) through outcome-level feedback, yet recent approaches to finer-grained credit assignment often require auxiliary models, additional sampling, or privileged information. Although policy entropy provides a readily available signal, prioritizing uncertain positions under both reinforcement and penalization concentrates penalties where failed responses still retain alternatives for recovery, which can suppress opportunities for exploration. To address this, we introduce Entropic Advantage Policy Optimization (EAPO), an entropy-guided credit assignment method that treats success and failure asymmetrically. translated_title: 意外的成功，重复的失败：面向大语言模型推理探索的熵引导信用分配
translated_abstract: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习通过结果层面的反馈来提升大语言模型的推理能力，然而近期实现更细粒度信用分配的方法往往需要辅助模型、额外采样或特权信息。尽管策略熵提供了一种易于获取的信号，但在强化与惩罚中同时优先考虑不确定位置的做法，会将惩罚集中到失败响应仍保有可供恢复的备选方案之处，从而可能抑制探索的机会。为解决这一问题，我们提出了熵优势策略优化，这是一种以熵引导的信用分配方法，对成功与失败采取不对称的处理方式。具体而言，受“不确定性下的成功不易复现，而高置信度的失败往往反复出现”这一观察的启发，EAPO将归一化的策略熵与响应优势的符号相结合，以强化令人惊喜的成功……
tldr: 提出熵优势策略优化，通过对成功与失败的不对称处理——强化不确定性下的“意外成功”、惩罚高置信度的“重复失败”——在无需辅助模型、额外采样或特权信息的情况下实现熵引导的信用分配，从而促进大语言模型推理中的探索。
en_tdlr: EAPO introduces entropy-guided credit assignment that treats success and failure asymmetrically—reinforcing surprising successes under uncertainty while penalizing confident, repeated failures—to foster exploration in LLM reasoning without requiring auxiliary models, extra sampling, or privileged information.
